comparison.objective: PR-360 caps and color-sorts four pens; the candidate calibrates and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-360 tests repeated cap-to-pen alignment, axial insertion, matching, and placement; the candidate tests tool seating, torque coordination, and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: PR-360 requires four matching retained caps and released pens in designated areas; the candidate requires accurate stop locking with low drift over cycles.
comparison.reason: Axial capping and sorting do not test preservation of a mechanical adjustment.
